about: Labelled tickets for the demo repos (scripts/fetch-context.sh capitalone/locopy capitalone/datacompy), pinned to the commits the guardian/data policy documents analysed. Targets come from each policy's section 5, 'Reusable Components'. Tickets avoid the function names. 'expand' simulates the skill's model step.

cases.ticket: Gzip a CSV extract before we push it to the staging bucket
Split a large extract into several smaller files so the warehouse can load them in parallel
Make sure secret keys never show up when we log the SQL we run
Load the warehouse connection settings from a YAML file
Work out Redshift column types for a dataframe before we create the table
Break an s3:// URL into its bucket and key
Show the percentage uploaded while a file is being sent to S3
Every object we write to S3 must be server-side encrypted with our KMS key
Keep sensitive columns such as account numbers out of the comparison report
Tell the user which pip extra to install when an optional backend like polars is missing
Generate a temporary column name that cannot clash with existing columns
Validate the per-column numeric tolerance settings a user passes in
Save the comparison report as an HTML file
Read Snowflake connection details from environment variables or a JSON file
Add OAuth2 login to the internal web dashboard
Stream change-data-capture events from Kafka into the ledger service
Translate user-facing error messages into French
